🚨 Fearless Dog mum saves 2 pups from raging fire in Mandaue City, Philippines. 🚨

As flames spread, Ei Mei Lee Maningo climbed onto a ladder, threw each Dog down to safety, then hung by her hands from the railing while firefighters climbed up to rescue her.  She survived with minor injuries. Her Dogs survived because she chose love over fear.  ❤️

Of course, she’s 1,000 per cent truly a hero. Only Dog, and Cat owners will understand. 🙏

Full Story: https://t.co/VyPjNgHC5p

data.raw_text: Faced with a fire, she first threw her dogs into the crowd before even thinking about her own safety. At the scene of the fire in Cebu, Philippines, a young woman made the bravest choice—she first entrusted two dogs from the third floor to people below, ensuring their safety before escaping herself. In the instant the thick smoke billowed and the flames approached, her first reaction wasn't to save herself, but to save the two little lives that depended on her. Ultimately, both the dogs and she escaped safely. #Guardian #Fire #HotNewsEvent #HotTopic #Dou #Firefighting

Oh, and the dogs 🐕 too are also doing fine.
